a novel method for the preparation of reagent less hydrogen peroxide biosensor was developed using a biocompatable non-toxic zrO2 enhanced grafted collagen matrix.
a new biosensor has been developed for the electrocatalytic determination of H(2)0(2) based on direct electrochemistry of Hb immobilized onto ZrO(3)-grafted gelatin matrix.
a novel method for the preparation of reagent-less hydrogen peroxide biosensor was proposed.

the design of a novel matrix for the construction of biosensors.

the preparation of a novel matrix for protein immobilizing and its application to biosensor fabrication, which has potential for further development in the fields of biosensor design and protein immobilization.
the design and preparation of a novel Hb-based biosensor with a high sensitivity and a low detection limit.

this study is a novel and promising strategy for preparation of biosensors and other biotechnological applications.
the proposed biosensor has the advantage of simple preparation, good electrochemical performance and high sensitivity, making it suitable for practical application.
this work provides a new and promising method for the immobilized enzyme preparation and the construction of biosensors with excellent properties.

the biosensor based on ZrO(3)-grafted tri-helix collagen matrix is an excellent platform for the immobilization and direct electrochemical investigation of biomolecules and biosensing application.

zirconia nanoparticles can be used for the immobilization and preparation of biosensors.
the ZrO2-gelatin matrix provides a novel method to prepare a biosensor for H2O2.
